synopsis: The 1993 festival. Unfiltered, unnarrated, and unlike anything else in British music film. The year is 1993 - the last of the great old-school Glastonburys, before the BBC arrived, before phone masts, biometric tickets and wall-to-wall coverage. A hundred thousand people in a Somerset field, completely unobserved, completely themselves. synopsis: After October 7th the world was shocked and sympathetic following the Hamas attacks in Israel. Within a few short months most of this sympathy had gone as the world recoiled in horror at the brutality of the Israeli response to these attacks, while 73% of Israeli Jews expressed support for this response. As a British-American Jew Gillian wanted to know what has happened to make these Jews, a people who have experienced oppression, othering, and genocide, exhibit such moral and humanitarian numbn
tmdb_overview: Why do 73% of Jewish Israelis support the destruction of Gaza?  Directed by BAFTA winning filmmaker Gillian Mosely, 'Planet Israel' answers this question.  Within a few short months after October 7, most of global sympathy towards Israel evaporated as the world recoiled in horror at the brutality of the Israeli response to these attacks, while few Israeli Jews seem to have noticed anything untoward.  As a British/American Jew, Gillian Mosely wanted to know what has happened to make Jews, a people who have experienced oppression, othering, and genocide, exhibit such moral and humanitarian numbness. More widely, how does the moral disengagement that allows atrocities the world over, happen? Gillian thought she was making a film about trauma. But the reality turned out to be so much darker than she’d imagined as the mechanisms behind our disintegrating democracies and international laws are exposed.

tmdb_overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

tmdb_overview: In 1985, Wham! were the first Western pop group to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s two concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. synopsis:
All of Us Strangers  & Q&A with Author, John Grindod
Genre(s): Drama/Fantasy/RomanceUK/USA| 2023 | 105 minsDirector: Andrew Haigh
Stars: Andrew Scott, Paul Mescal, Jamie Bell, Claire Foy

A special screening of Andrew
Haigh's All of Us Strangers, a film beloved of queer
Croydonians, not least because it was set and shot in the borough. The
screening will be followed by a Q&A with Croydon-born writer John Grindrod
discussing the film and the many themes it shares with his new book, Tales
of the Suburbs: LGBTQ+ Lives Behind Net Curtains. Discover stories
of isolation and escape, love and community; and prepare to be devastated all
over again by one of the great modern movies, back in its spiritual home. 

This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy

Followed by Q&A with author John Grindrod, in partnership with Croydon Pride.

John Grindrod is a social historian of modern places. From
New Addington, he is the author of four books: Tales of the Suburbs: LGBTQ+ Lives
Behind Net Curtains, Concretopia, Outskirts and Iconicon. All his books touch
on his beloved Croydon. He also runs the podcast Monstrosities Mon Amour where guests share their love of places
everyone else hates. johngrindrod.co.uk

About Tales of the Suburbs: LGBTQ+ Lives Behind Net
Curtains
'[A] fantastically entertaining alternative history of queer life in Britain .
. .worthy of Victoria Wood.' Guardian
Throughout LGBTQ+ history, suburbia has been seen as
somewhere to escape from: a place where heterosexuality rules; where difference
will not be tolerated; where you'll never find a soulmate. But for many, those
streets of twitching curtains and pebble-dashed semis were - or still are - a
place to call home.
From Addlestone to Wilmslow, Tales of the Suburbs:
LGBTQ+ Lives Behind Net Curtains explores the relatively untold twentieth
century tale of lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and queer people in small towns
and suburbia. Through remarkable archive material (much of which follows the
fortunes of the Croydon Area Gay Society from the 1970s onwards) and original
interviews, social historian John Grindrod reveals stories that are messy and
moving, dark and funny, uplifting and extraordinary. Together, they reclaim
suburbia as a space for all - or those that want it - where counter-cultural
expression thrives despite the Neighbourhood Watch, and queer love and
friendship bloom against the odds.
tmdb_overview: One night in his near-empty tower block in contemporary London, Adam has a chance encounter with a mysterious neighbor, which punctures the rhythm of his everyday life.

synopsis:
An American in Paris 
Genre(s): Romance/MusicalUSA | 1951 | 113 minsDirector: Vincente MinnelliStars: Gene Kelly, Leslie Caron, Oscar Levant
Based
on George Gershwin’s tone poem of the same name, which accompanies the ballet
sequence at the film’s climax, as well as songs from the Gershwin catalogue,
this multi-Oscar winning musical stars Kelly as Jerry, a WWII veteran
struggling to succeed as an artist, who falls for Lise (Caron), without
realising she is the girlfriend of his best friend, French singer Henri. Among
other delights in the film is a sequence where Oscar Levant dreams of playing
Gershwin’s Piano Concerto in F – and becomes the conductor, the other musicians
and even a member of the audience!
tmdb_overview: Jerry Mulligan is an exuberant American expatriate in Paris trying to make a reputation as a painter. His friend Adam is a struggling concert pianist who's a long time associate of a famous French singer, Henri Baurel. A lonely society woman, Milo Roberts, takes Jerry under her wing and supports him, but is interested in more than his art.

synopsis:
ARCO
Genre(s): AnimationUSA | 2026 | 88 minsDirector: Ugo BienvenuFamily Film Club screening in association with Croydon Family Hubs: Tickets £6
In 2075, 10-year-old Iris sees a mysterious boy
in a rainbow jumpsuit falling from the sky. Arco comes from a distant, idyllic

synopsis:
Birds of War 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUK/Syria/Lebanon | 2026 | 85 mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Directors: Janay Boulos, Abd Alkader HabakBirds of War follows
London-based Lebanese journalist Janay Boulos and Syrian activist photographer
Abd Alkader Habak as they piece together their extraordinary long-distance
relationship through 13 years of personal footage, spanning years of
revolutions, war, displacement and exile. From the devastation of Aleppo to a
London newsroom, the film offers an intimate view of life on the frontline and
the emotional turmoil of conflict. Both a powerful documentary and a deeply
personal love story, it asks whether love can survive distance, danger,
profound change and differences. Sundance Film Festival 2026, World Cinema
Documentary Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact.
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis:
Cactus Pears  +ShortGenre(s): DramaUK/India/Canada | 2025 | 112 mins (Marathi with English Subtitles)Director: Rohan KanawadeStars: Bhushaan Manoj, Suraaj Suman, Jayshri Jagtap, Nitin Bansode, Harish Baraskar, Ram Daund, Vidya Joshi, Hemant Kadam, Rani Kasliwal, Vaishali Kendale
Cactus Pears is a
tender and deeply personal drama set against the striking landscapes of rural
Western India. Following the death of his father, Anand returns from Mumbai to
his ancestral village to observe traditional mourning rituals. Amid mounting
family expectations to marry, he finds an unexpected refuge in Balya, a
childhood friend. As old bonds are rekindled, their connection deepens into
something more. Beautifully shot, Kanawade’s debut is a subtle, moving
exploration of grief, identity and love. Sundance Film Festival 2025 World
Cinema Grand Jury Prize winner. 
Preceded by Two Black Boys in Paradise (9 mins), a
BAFTA-winning animated short.
tmdb_overview: Anand, a 30-something city dweller compelled to spend a 10-day mourning period for his father in the rugged countryside of western India, tenderly bonds with a local farmer who is struggling to stay unmarried. As the mourning ends, forcing his return, Anand must decide the fate of his relationship born under duress.

synopsis:
Come See Me In the Good Light 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUSA | 2025 ! 104 minsDirector: Ryan
WhiteCast: Megan Falley, Andrea Gibson
Introduction and Q&A with Jo Scanlan and Mia Bayes, Director of BFI Filmmaking Fund
Tickets are free but please consider making a donation to the cinema when booking.

This Oscar-nominated
documentary tells the story of poets and lovers Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley,
and how they deal with the former’s diagnosis of ovarian cancer. Through the
highs and lows of the ongoing treatment, the partners attempt to live a full
and happy life, which the film reflects through their poetry, prose, raunchy
jokes and bedtime whispers. A celebration of queer love under the deepest of
traumas.

tmdb_original_title: Come See Me in the Good Light
tmdb_overview: In an intimate and joyful story of love in the face of loss, celebrated poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley find strength—and unexpected hilarity—in what might be their final year together.

synopsis:
Effi O Blaenau 
Genre(s): DramaUK| 2026| 91 mins (Welsh with English Subtitles).Director: Marc EvansStars: Leisa Gwenllian, Tom Rhys Harries, Owen Alun
Based on the acclaimed
one-woman play Iphigenia in Splott, this Welsh-language film version moves the action to the
North Wales town of Blaenau, a dreary place
surrounded by grey slate tips, where Effi tries desperately to enjoy life on
the dole through a haze of clubbing and alcohol. An encounter with a disabled
soldier seems to promise her some hope, but things soon descend into chaos… But
Effi fights back. Leisa Gwenllian gives a tour-de-force
performance as Effi, and aided by Evans’s direction, she has you rooting for
her character as fate and the elements conspire against her. An affecting and
moving drama in the British social realist tradition.
This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy
tmdb_overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

Genre: DramaUK | 2025 | 89 minsDirector: Imran PerrettaStars: Farhan Hasnat, Yahya Kitana, Sudha BhucharSet in Luton, this coming-of-age drama
follows 12-year-old best friends Ish and Maram (non-professional actors Farhan
Hasnat and Yahya Kitana, themselves friends since childhood) as they try to
make the most of their summer. After a traumatic police stop-and-search
incident, cracks begin to appear in their friendship, forcing the boys to
confront the realities of growing up in a world that views them with
suspicion.As their lives gradually
diverge, each must make sense of the men they are becoming and learn that
letting go can be one of the hardest parts of growing up. A contemporary
portrait of British childhood exploring masculinity, friendship and racial
profiling and facial recognition technology with compassion and insight.

Dewaels
NINO contains a sequence of flashing lights, 
which might affect viewers with photosensitive epilepsy.
One Friday in Paris, his 29th birthday, Nino
receives an unexpected cancer diagnosis. With chemotherapy due to start on
Monday, he is given the delicate task of producing a sperm sample in case the
treatment leaves him infertile. This incredibly moving and often funny French
drama sees Nino spend the weekend adrift in Paris, attempting to
reconnect with others and stumbling over the words to share his shocking news.
Théodore Pellerin's tender performance won prizes at both Cannes and the Césars

Dewaels
NINO contains a sequence of flashing lights, 
which might affect viewers with photosensitive epilepsy.
One Friday in Paris, his 29th birthday, Nino
receives an unexpected cancer diagnosis. With chemotherapy due to start on
Monday, he is given the delicate task of producing a sperm sample in case the
treatment leaves him infertile. This incredibly moving and often funny French
drama sees Nino spend the weekend adrift in Paris, attempting to
reconnect with others and stumbling over the words to share his shocking news.
Théodore Pellerin's tender performance won prizes at both Cannes and the Césars
in this promising debut feature.

synopsis:
NT Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses 
Genre: Theatrical PerformanceUK | 2026 | 180 minsDirector: Marianne ElliottStars: Lesley Manville, Aidan Turner, Monica Barbaro
BAFTA Award-winner Lesley Manville (Phantom Thread) joins
Aidan Turner (Rivals) in a striking new staging of Christopher Hampton’s
celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons
of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin.  Marquise de Merteuil is a
master in the art of survival. Alongside the magnetic Vicomte de Valmont, they
turn seduction into strategy and weaponise desire. But when their alliance
collapses into rivalry, the battle between them threatens to destroy everyone
in their path. Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Marianne Elliott (Angels
in America) directs this thrilling game of love, lies, and social warfare.
There will be a 15 minute interval at the end of act 1. Our Arts Bar will reopen to allow customers to purchase drinks and snacks to take into the cinema.

Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) plays the title
role in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic dark comedy.Telling the truth isn’t always that
simple.Alice, a brilliant novelist,
despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society. But the more she
challenges those around her, the fiercer the backlash becomes.Soon, she must confront the price of speaking
her truth in a world that would rather silence her.

Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Indhu
Rubasingham directs Martin Crimp’s (Cyrano de Bergerac) highly
anticipated play.

synopsis:
Primavera 
Genre(s): Biography/History/Drama/MusicItaly/France | 2025 | 111 mins (Italian with English Subtitles)Director: Damiano MichielettoCast: Tecla Insolia, Michele Riondino, Fabrizia SacchiPrimaverais
set in 18th-century Venice, where Cecilia, a gifted violinist raised in an
orphanage, performs in its all-female orchestra while destined for an arranged
marriage to a wealthy benefactor. The arrival of Antonio Vivaldi as her teacher
begins to change the course of her life, his music opening up new
possibilities. As Cecilia questions the institution’s strict rules, she must
decide whether to follow the future planned for her or pursue her own
ambitions. This music-led historical drama features a standout score worth
staying for through the final credits.
tmdb_overview: In 18th-century Venice, 20-year-old violin virtuoso Cecilia lives at the Pièta orphanage, where, despite her talent, she remains confined, knowing that marriage is the only way out. Yet, her life takes a turn after she meets Antonio Vivaldi, a brilliant and ambitious composer who becomes the new violin teacher. Guided by Vivaldi and his music, Cecilia finds the strength to challenge the destiny that once seemed inevitable.

synopsis:
Savage House 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaUK | 2025 | 114 minsDirector: Peter GlanzStars: Richard E Grant, Claire Foy, Jack Farthing, Bel PowleyOur 2:30pm screening includes Descriptive subtitles for those with hearing difficulties.England,
1740. Lady Vane and Lord Ashwick will do anything to claw their way to the top
of society - lie, scheme, blackmail, and butcher their way through polite
company if they must. Claire Foy and Richard E. Grant star in this deliciously
vicious period romp, where corsets are tight, morals are loose, and the body
count keeps rising. Sharp-tongued, blood-splattered, and wickedly funny, Savage
House skewers the brutal absurdity of class obsession with gleeful,
unapologetic savagery.
tmdb_overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

synopsis:
Stand By Me 
Genre(s): Adventure| Comedy | DramaUSA 1986 | 88 minsDirector: Rob ReinerStars: Wil Wheaton, River Phoenix, Corey Feldman, Jerry O'Connell, Kiefer Sutherland.Our 2pm screening will be followed by a post-film discussion hosted by the U3A film club. Everyone is welcome to stay and join in.The late Rob Reiner directed this version of
Stephen King’s novella The Body to great critical and popular acclaim. A writer
(played by Richard Dreyfuss) looks back to the time when he and three friends
set out on a journey to find the body of a missing boy. The friends hope
finding the body will make them heroes, but instead their friendship is
strengthened. The film pays tribute to the icons and beliefs of the fifties,
but still remains well-observed without falling to over-used nostalgia. “A masterclass
in directing, storytelling and acting” (The Guardian).
tmdb_overview: After learning that a boy their age has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four boys decide to go see the body. Gordie, Vern, Chris, and Teddy encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, but they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives.

synopsis:
The Devil Wears Prada 2 
Genres: Comedy/DramaUSA | 2025 | 119 minsDirector: David FrankelCast: Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci
Twenty years on, The Devil Wears Prada 2
struts back onto the scene with its original cast and a fresh dose of
high-fashion drama. Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) — ice-cold stare intact —
is fighting to keep her fashion magazine Runway relevant as the print media
world crumbles. Her former protégé Anne Hathaway returns in considerably better
shoes, but it's former assistant-turned-rival Emily Blunt who may prove
Miranda's most formidable foe yet. Stilettos are sharpened, alliances tested,
and the drama is more fabulous than ever.
This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy
tmdb_overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

synopsis:
The Dresser 
Genre(s): DramaUK | 1983 | 118 minsDirector: Peter YatesStars: Albert Finney, Tom Courtenay, Edward Fox, Eileen Atkins, Betty Marsden.
Ronald Harwood adapted his own acclaimed play, which was
based on his own experiences working as a dresser for actor-manager Sir Donald
Wolfit, portrayed as ‘Sir’. Sir is leading a theatre group performing
Shakespeare in the provinces during the war, but his mental capacities are
beginning to fade, and Norman, his dresser, has the task of nursing him into
another performance of King Lear. Courtenay recreates his theatre performance
as the sensitive Norman and Finney delivers a barn-storming Sir.
A 35mm presentation in association with The Cinema Museum.
tmdb_overview: One fateful night in a small English regional theatre during World War II a troupe of touring actors stage a production of Shakespeares King Lear. Bombs are falling, sirens are wailing, the curtain is up in an hour but the actor/manager Sir who is playing Lear is nowhere to be seen. His dresser Norman must scramble to keep the production alive but will Sir turn up in time and if he does will he be able to perform that night? The Dresser is a wickedly funny and deeply moving story of friendship and loyalty as Sir reflects on his lifelong accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

synopsis:
The Girls (Gehenu Lamai) 
Genre: DramaSri Lanka | 1978 | 110 mins (Sinhala with English Subtitles)Director: Sumitra PeriesStars: Vasanthi Chathurani, Ajith Jinadasa, Shayama AnandanThe BFI have released this
restoration of this well-loved film from 1978. Set in rural Sri Lanka, it tells
of schoolgirl Kusum, who cleans the house of a wealthy family, including their
son Nimal. He volunteers to tutor her through her exams, and although she knows
it will be frowned upon, she forms a romantic attachment to him. Meanwhile, her
younger sister Soma, enters beauty pageants and dreams of becoming a movie star
and escaping her lowly existence. Both Vasanthi Chathurani, who plays Kusum,
and director Sumitra Peries went on to have distinguished careers in Sri Lankan
cinema.

The Last Viking 
Genre(s): Comedy/Crime/DramaDenmark/Sweden | 2025 | 116 mins (Danish with English Subtitles)Director: Anders Thomas JensenStars: Mads Mikkelsen, Sofie Gråbøl, Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Lars Ranthe, John LennonBank robber Anker entrusts the loot from
his latest robbery with his brother Manfred just before he is captured. On his
release from prison, he seeks out his brother, but Manfred now believes himself
to be John Lennon – and he cannot remember where the money is buried. Empathy
between the brothers is not helped by Ankers’s short temper. They return to
their childhood holiday home, where the loot may be hidden, to work things out,
joined by a group of other characters (played by Sofie Gråbøl and other
well-known faces from TV Scandi noir). A well-acted black comedy, full of
hilarious misadventures and fun slapstick sequences.
tmdb_overview: After serving fourteen years for robbery, Anker is released from prison and reunites with his mentally ill brother Manfred, who alone knows where the stolen money is hidden but has forgotten its location, sending them on a journey to recover the loot and confront who they are.

The Sheep Detectives 
Genre(s) Comedy/Action/Mystery/FamilyUK/USA/Ireland | 2026 | 109 minsDirector: Kyle BaldaCast: Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, Emma Thompson
George
Hardy is a shepherd living in a quiet English rural community, keeping himself
to himself, and reading crime books to his flock every evening. Little does he
know that they understand every word, and when he is discovered dead, the sheep
suspect foul play and start to investigate under the noses of the incompetent
local police. The talking sheep are voiced by an array of British and American
screen talent and Emma Thompson delivers a great cameo as George’s solicitor.
Think Babe meets The Thursday Murder Club.
tmdb_overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story 5 and this time it’s toy meets tech.
With Woody now helping lost toys alongside Bo Peep, Jessie has taken charge of
Bonnie's room, supported by Buzz. But when Bonnie becomes captivated by
Lilypad, a new tablet-like toy voiced by Greta Lee, the gang find themselves

Niki, a young piano tuner and apprentice to octogenarian
Harry, suffers from an extreme auditory sensitivity. This hyperacusis aids his
work but when Harry falls ill, it accidentally presents Niki with a way to pay
mounting medical bills as he cracks safes for Uri and his suspect security
firm. The central relationship between Niki and concert pianist and aspiring
composer Ruthie rings true in its complexity as the tension builds. Stylishly
shot with snappy editing and a cracking score, this debut feature cleverly
combines taut suspense and relationship drama in present day New York.

tmdb_overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

tmdb_overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

Shoot The People is a documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Renowned for his wide-ranging work — including powerful breakthrough images from the 2020 Black Lives Matter protests and capturing the Palestinian liberation movement on film — Harriman also made history as the first Black man to photograph a British Vogue cover.

The film follows Harriman as he highlights the
tmdb_overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

synopsis: The Summer Book follows an intergenerational family spending a transformative summer at their rustic vacation home on an unspoiled, remote island in the Gulf of Finland. Adapted from Tove Jansson’s beloved novel, the film explores grief, nature, and the delicate bonds between a young girl, her wise grandmother (Glenn Close), and her grieving father (Anders Danielsen Lie).
tmdb_overview: The story of the relationship between Sophia, an eight-year-old girl who is growing up fast, and her grandmother, who is nearing the end of her life. They are spending time together with Sophia’s father, at the family summer house on a tiny unspoiled island in the Gulf of Finland. All three are coming to terms with the recent death of Sophia’s mother in very different ways.

A beloved musician transitions and risks everything - including his voice - to live authentically as Dylan Holloway.
tmdb_overview: A singer’s voice—and identity—evolve in this raw, lyrical journey through gender transition, loss, and self-discovery. British artist Dylan Holloway, formerly known as Lots Holloway, stepped away from the spotlight during the 2020 lockdown to begin his gender transition. Once a rising star on the UK’s X-Factor, Dylan now faces a profound personal and professional crossroads: hormone therapy could irreversibly change the voice that once defined his career. Blending candid video diaries, family footage, and intimate interviews, Tomorrow’s Too Late traces Dylan’s early life, his struggle with identity, and the emotional toll of life lived in public. At once a music documentary and a deeply moving portrait of trans experience, the film captures the courage it takes to risk everything in pursuit of an authentic self.

Once a rising star on the UK’s X-Factor, Dylan now faces a profound personal and professional crossroads: hormone therapy could irreversibly change the voice that once defined his career. Blending candid video diaries, family footage, and intimate interviews, Tomorrow’s Too Late traces Dylan’s early life, his struggle with identity, and the emotional toll of life lived in public. At once a music documentary and a deeply moving portrait of trans experience, the film captures the courage it takes to risk everything in pursuit of an authentic self.

tmdb_overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

Sharing her story alongside a close network of trans individuals, one of the world's favourite drag performers takes you inside her rise from humble begi...
tmdb_title: A Deeper Love: The Story of Miss Peppermint
tmdb_original_title: A Deeper Love: The Story of Miss Peppermint
tmdb_overview: Drag Race star Peppermint takes center stage in this up close and personal documentary about her journey with fame, identity, and the art of drag. Sharing her story alongside a close network of trans individuals, one of the world’s favorite drag performers takes you inside her rise from humble beginnings to her current reign as outspoken trailblazer for the trans community.

synopsis: Grab your latest project and join us for a night of crafting and fun. Whether you’re knitting, crocheting, sewing, bring your work-in-progress and get ready for a cosy evening with an excellent movie. A collaboration between Coldharbour Blue and Craft Forward.

Join us for a special screening of Death Becomes Her (1992), the iconic dark comedy. Funny, sharp, and endlessly quotable, it’s a celebration of camp cinema and the pressures of beauty, ageing, and perfection. We’ll also be celebrating the film’s recent return to pop culture, including its influence on Sabrina Carpenter’s latest music video, with a short feature before the screening and a few fun surprises throughout the afternoon.

synopsis: A Russian writer becomes overwhelmed with homesickness in Andrei Tarkovsky’s deeply personal film.
tmdb_overview: Russian poet Andrei Gorchakov journeys through Italy with his interpreter Eugenia to research the life of an 18th-century Russian composer who once lived abroad. Isolated and consumed by an unrelenting longing for his homeland, Andrei becomes drawn to Domenico, a radical mystic obsessed with spiritual redemption. Through austere imagery and extended temporal rhythms, Tarkovsky examines exile, memory, and the profound melancholy of being unable to belong fully to either place or language.

synopsis: Agnès Varda’s tale of what happened to a solitary hitchhiker is told in flashback, through the experiences of those who came into contact with her.

Through these flashbacks, Mona gradually declines as she travels from place to place, taking odd jobs and staying with whomever will offer her a place to sleep. Mona is fiercely independent, craving freedom over comfort, but it is this desire to be free that will eventually lead to her demise.

movie_title: Toddler Club: The Scarecrows' Wedding + The Smeds and the Smoos
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: The Scarecrows' Wedding + The Smeds and the Smoos
director: Samantha Cutler, Jeroen Jaspaert, Daniel Snaddon
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE SCARECROWS' WEDDING
Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. 

THE SMEDS & THE SMOOS
Bill and Janet fall in love while their families are at war. Faced with disapproval, they flee to a distant planet and Grandma Smoo and Grandpa Smed must put aside their differences and work together to bring them back home.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech.

synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pokémon Detective Pikachu - when Tim Goodman travels to Ryme City to settle the affairs of his late father, he meets an intelligent talking Pokémon, a Pikachu, and soon teams up with it to solve his father's last case.

synopsis: A new documentary following George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley in 1985 as they become the first Western band to perform in communist China ahead of their break into global superstardom. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley's concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For WHAM!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom. Now, newly remastered, this film shows China on the cusp of change, told through the band's journey and the voices of fans experiencing pop culture for the first time. This is the untold story of WHAM! at a singular moment in history, East meets West, pop meets politics, and two young stars coming of age on the world stage.
tmdb_overview: In 1985, Wham! were the first Western pop group to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s two concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For Wham!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom, and it worked.

synopsis:

synopsis: A new documentary following George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley in 1985 as they become the first Western band to perform in communist China ahead of their break into global superstardom. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley's concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For WHAM!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom. Now, newly remastered, this film shows China on the cusp of change, told through the band's journey and the voices of fans experiencing pop culture for the first time. This is the untold story of WHAM! at a singular moment in history, East meets West, pop meets politics, and two young stars coming of age on the world stage.

synopsis: An inspirational portrait of a farmer’s son who rises from humble beginnings to build a luxury fashion empire. BRUNELLO: THE GRACIOUS VISIONARY traces the pivotal moments that shaped Brunello Cucinelli's life journey, exploring his commitment to craftsmanship, ethical values and humanistic philosophy rooted in meaningful relationships and a strong sense of community. Directed by Academy Award® winner Giuseppe Tornatore (Cinema Paradiso) and featuring a score by Academy Award® winner Nicola Piovani (Life Is Beautiful), the film blends documentary and fiction to offer an intimate look at the renowned Italian entrepreneur known as the “king of cashmere.”

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own.

movie_title_en: Toddler Club: The Scarecrows' Wedding + The Smeds and the Smoos
director: Samantha Cutler, Jeroen Jaspaert, Daniel Snaddon
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE SCARECROWS' WEDDING
Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. 

THE SMEDS & THE SMOOS
Bill and Janet fall in love while their families are at war. Faced with disapproval, they flee to a distant planet and Grandma Smoo and Grandpa Smed must put aside their differences and work together to bring them back home.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

synopsis: An inspirational portrait of a farmer’s son who rises from humble beginnings to build a luxury fashion empire. BRUNELLO: THE GRACIOUS VISIONARY traces the pivotal moments that shaped Brunello Cucinelli's life journey, exploring his commitment to craftsmanship, ethical values and humanistic philosophy rooted in meaningful relationships and a strong sense of community. Directed by Academy Award® winner Giuseppe Tornatore (Cinema Paradiso) and featuring a score by Academy Award® winner Nicola Piovani (Life Is Beautiful), the film blends documentary and fiction to offer an intimate look at the renowned Italian entrepreneur known as the “king of cashmere.”
tmdb_overview: A farmer's son transforms into a fashion mogul, building a billion-dollar luxury empire while staying true to his humanistic values and commitment to ethical business practices and fine craftsmanship.

Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis: A new documentary following George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley in 1985 as they become the first Western band to perform in communist China ahead of their break into global superstardom. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley's concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For WHAM!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom. Now, newly remastered, this film shows China on the cusp of change, told through the band's journey and the voices of fans experiencing pop culture for the first time. This is the untold story of WHAM! at a singular moment in history, East meets West, pop meets politics, and two young stars coming of age on the world stage.
tmdb_overview: In 1985, Wham! were the first Western pop group to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s two concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For Wham!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom, and it worked.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

movie_title: Toddler Club: The Scarecrows' Wedding + The Smeds and the Smoos
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: The Scarecrows' Wedding + The Smeds and the Smoos
director: Samantha Cutler, Jeroen Jaspaert, Daniel Snaddon
synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE SCARECROWS' WEDDING
Two devoted scarecrows, Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay, are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, a smooth-talking scarecrow named Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. 

THE SMEDS & THE SMOOS
Bill and Janet fall in love while their families are at war. Faced with disapproval, they flee to a distant planet and Grandma Smoo and Grandpa Smed must put aside their differences and work together to bring them back home.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: An inspirational portrait of a farmer’s son who rises from humble beginnings to build a luxury fashion empire. BRUNELLO: THE GRACIOUS VISIONARY traces the pivotal moments that shaped Brunello Cucinelli's life journey, exploring his commitment to craftsmanship, ethical values and humanistic philosophy rooted in meaningful relationships and a strong sense of community. Directed by Academy Award® winner Giuseppe Tornatore (Cinema Paradiso) and featuring a score by Academy Award® winner Nicola Piovani (Life Is Beautiful), the film blends documentary and fiction to offer an intimate look at the renowned Italian entrepreneur known as the “king of cashmere.”
tmdb_overview: A farmer's son transforms into a fashion mogul, building a billion-dollar luxury empire while staying true to his humanistic values and commitment to ethical business practices and fine craftsmanship.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

In 18th-century France, an arrogant prince is cursed by an enchantress to live as a hideous Beast. To break the spell, he must earn the love of a spirited village girl named Belle before the enchanted rose loses all its petals. Belle takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner, eventually uncovering his kind heart.

The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.

Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
In 18th-century France, an arrogant prince is cursed by an enchantress to live as a hideous Beast. To break the spell, he must earn the love of a spirited village girl named Belle before the enchanted rose loses all its petals. Belle takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner, eventually uncovering his kind heart.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:

Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
In 18th-century France, an arrogant prince is cursed by an enchantress to live as a hideous Beast. To break the spell, he must earn the love of a spirited village girl named Belle before the enchanted rose loses all its petals. Belle takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner, eventually uncovering his kind heart.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movie_title: Paw Patrol 3: The Dino Movie - MediCinema Preview
movie_title_en: Paw Patrol 3: The Dino Movie - MediCinema Preview
synopsis:
Join us Sunday, 2nd August, for an early charity screening preview of Paw Patrol 3: The Dino Movie in support of MediCinema - a unique charity operating at the heart of NHS hospitals, offering therapeutic cinema experiences to improve the mental, emotional and physical well-being of patients and their loved ones. All the proceeds from the event will be donated to MediCinema.

After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
